text.content: Starting from c762c793b1fccd7f3d43dc2220d4b0f6685b8a44, make cross-replan visual memory structurally non-bypassable through fixed-scale per-layer cross-attention and FiLM, supervise a memory-only future-action decoder from the pre-transformer noisy-action seed, and add adjacent-history temporal correspondence prediction. Experiment CWAM-COSMOS3-B5-VOM-PROBE-R3-20260817 keeps the R2 B4 warm start, frozen video expert, 500-step eight-B200 budget, and identical 2048-sample none/zero/shuffle gate. Formal training remains blocked unless aligned main action loss beats both interventions by at least 1 percent and all finite/checkpoint/slot-diversity gates pass.
